description: Two small languages a caller must not be allowed to write. Neither is a path and neither is a protocol: a glob pattern chooses which files a program walks rather than which file it opens, and text built into an XML document is the caller writing syntax -- the same evidence SQL injection rests on, at a different interpreter. Three negatives: each language ships the escaper that proves the point, and a document the caller SENT is a different question judged by what the parser was asked to resolve.

expected.note: choosing a PATTERN is not choosing a path, which is why the two are reported apart
built INTO the document rather than carried by it -- the same evidence SQL injection rests on, at a different interpreter
